title: Protein & Fullness
summary: Protein is the most filling macronutrient. Understanding why - and how to use it - can make eating less feel effortless.

steps.heading: Why protein keeps you full longer
steps.body: Of the three macronutrients, protein suppresses hunger most effectively. It slows how quickly your stomach empties and triggers the release of satiety hormones like GLP-1 and PYY. The result is that a protein-rich meal keeps you feeling full for longer than the same number of calories from carbs or fat.

steps.heading: The thermic effect: protein costs more to digest
steps.body: Your body burns roughly 20–30% of a protein's calories just digesting and processing it - compared to about 5–10% for carbohydrates and 0–3% for fat. This means high-protein foods deliver fewer net calories than their label suggests, giving you a small but real metabolic advantage.

steps.heading: Muscle preservation during a calorie deficit
steps.body: When you eat less than you burn, your body will use both fat and muscle for energy. Eating enough protein - around 1.2–1.6 g per kg of body weight - helps protect muscle mass. More muscle means a higher resting metabolic rate, which makes maintaining a healthy weight easier over time.

steps.heading: Simple ways to add protein to each meal
steps.body: You don't need protein shakes. Eggs, Greek yoghurt, cottage cheese, legumes, tofu, fish, and lean meat are all practical sources. Aim to have a palm-sized serving of protein at each meal. Starting meals with protein before eating carbohydrates can also help you eat less overall.

steps.heading: High protein doesn't mean no carbs
steps.body: Protein works best alongside balanced eating, not as a replacement for carbohydrates. Whole food carbs provide fibre, vitamins, and sustained energy. The goal is to make protein a consistent, prominent part of your plate - not to eliminate other food groups.

takeaway: Prioritising protein at each meal is one of the most practical levers for managing hunger and protecting muscle. It doesn't require complicated tracking - just ensure every meal has a clear protein source.
